name: 21-box-sizing
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.5; } .cb { box-sizing: content-box; width: 200px; padding: 10px; border: 3px solid #3366cc; background-color: #eef3ff; } .bb { box-sizing: border-box; width: 200px; padding: 10px; border: 3px solid #cc3366; background-color: #ffeef3; } .auto { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #333; }
html:
content-box 宽 200px 再加 padding 与 border
border-box 宽 200px 已含 padding 与 border
auto 宽度含 padding 的整行盒，右侧应当不留空隙
